svg.title: MQA and GQA share K/V heads to shrink the cache
svg.desc: Multi-query attention keeps all query heads but shares one key/value head; grouped-query attention shares one key/value head per group. Cache size scales with the number of K/V heads G relative to query heads h; only W_K and W_V shrink.

g.text: MQA and GQA share K/V heads to shrink the cache
MHA has one K/V pair per query head; GQA groups queries; MQA shares one pair.
EIGHT QUERY HEADS · DIFFERENT K/V SHARING
one K/V pair per query head
two query heads share each K/V
all eight share one K/V pair
KV-cache size scales with G/h: MHA 1× · GQA ½× · MQA ⅛× for h=8.
Only W_K and W_V shrink; GQA trades a little sharing for better quality than MQA.
